_comment: Robinhood Chain testnet. Addresses come from ../contracts/deployments/46630.json; this file holds only the numbers the keeper chooses. sharedKeysAllowed mirrors deployerIsAdmin in contracts/config/46630.json (D-105): on this chain one funded key is admin, guardian, treasury and keeper, and MockDeployLib mints it a million USDG, so the separation-of-duties startup assertions are all false by design and are reported as a TESTNET DEVIATION banner instead of refusing to start. It must be false on 4663.
label: robinhood-testnet

pricing._comment: See src/pricing/reserve.ts. The reserve is a floor, not a forecast: Black-Scholes at trailing realised vol sits below fair value by construction, which is the right direction of error for a number whose job is to stop a careless keeper selling calls for nothing (D-027). Variance accrues on a session clock, not a calendar one — a weekend series spans 2.16 calendar days and zero trading sessions, and pricing it on calendar time would make every weekend auction skip.

testnetUpkeep._comment: Off here; the `testnet-demo` compose profile turns it on with TESTNET_UPKEEP=true (src/jobs/testnetUpkeep.ts). A stock-feed round every 4 h on a ±40 bps random walk held inside ±8 % of the anchor, a USDG/USD round at par ±5 bps on the same cadence, a pool observation every 10 min at the feed's price. Only accepted on 46630.

SPY._comment: SPEC 7.2 and D-011 give the ETF weekday default as 200 bps, which is below the protocol floor STRIKE_LO_WEEKDAY = 300 and reverts DistanceOutOfBounds(200, 300, 1500). Verified against the live deployment: strikeDistanceBounds(SPY, WEEKDAY) = (300, 1500). 300 is used here and the conflict is recorded in DECISIONS D-109; the keeper validates this against the chain at startup and refuses to run rather than clamping.
